summary: VS Code integrated-terminal walkthrough used real CMD, Windows PowerShell 5.1, and PowerShell 7 terminals from a temporary extension. Each profile ran doctor at repository root and vscode-extension nested cwd; all six JSON outputs parsed with ok=true, 13/13 checks true, and launcher-probe=true. Each profile then ran the three hook matrix regressions; all nine process exit markers were 0 and all three logs ended with Ran 3 tests / OK.
